description: Returns full detail for a single device, including WAN, cellular, WiFi, VPN, firewall rules, subscription, and GPS location.

pathParameters.name: workspaceID
pathParameters.description: Workspace UUID. Obtain from API call: GET /v1/mobility/workspaces

pathParameters.name: deviceID
pathParameters.description: Device UUID. Obtain from API call: GET /v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/devices

children.name: model
children.description: Hardware model name. - `UMR` — UMR Flex EU/US - `UMR Industrial` — UMR Industrial EU/US - `UMR Ultra` — UMR Ultra EU/US/ROW

children.name: state
children.description: Current device state. | Value | Description | |-------|-------------| | `CONNECTED` | Online and communicating normally | | `DISCONNECTED` | Lost connection to the cloud | | `ADOPTING` | Adoption in progress | | `ADOPTING_TIMEOUT` | Adoption timed out | | `DOWNLOADING` | Downloading firmware update | | `UPGRADING` | Applying firmware update | | `RESTARTING` | Rebooting | | `FACTORY_RESET` | Performing factory reset | | `GETTING_READY` | Initialising after adoption | | `RESTORING` | Restoring from backup | | `NULL` | Record exists but adoption not started | | `DELETING` | Cloud-side deletion in progress |

children.name: mac_address
children.description: Primary MAC address in upper-case colon-separated format. Empty string when not yet initialised.

children.name: wan_source
children.description: Active WAN interface. Empty when no WAN connected.

children.name: wan_ip
children.description: Public WAN IP. Empty when not connected.

children.name: enabled_wans
children.description: Enabled WAN interfaces sorted by priority (index 0 = highest).

children.name: lte_signal_level
children.description: LTE signal quality derived from RSSI (dBm). | Value | RSSI range | Description | |-------|-----------|-------------| | `NO_SIGNAL` | < -111 dBm | No usable signal | | `POOR` | -111 to -100 dBm | Weak signal | | `FAIR` | -99 to -89 dBm | Moderate signal | | `STRONG` | -88 dBm or better | Good signal | | `""` | N/A | RSSI not yet reported |

children.name: cellular_data_usage_bytes
children.description: Data consumed in the current billing cycle, in bytes.

children.name: cellular_data_limit_bytes
children.description: Data cap in bytes for the current billing cycle. `-1` means unlimited. `0` is not a valid value.

children.name: uptime_seconds
children.description: Seconds since last boot. `0` when state is not `CONNECTED`.

children.name: host_address
children.description: LAN gateway IP. Contains WAN IP in `WANBRIDGE` mode.

children.name: device_mode
children.description: - `ROUTER` — standard NAT router - `WANBRIDGE` — WAN bridge mode - `LTEPASS` — LTE passthrough

children.name: tx_power_level
children.description: Empty when Wireless record is not initialised.

children.name: vpn_profile_name
children.description: Empty when no VPN is configured.

children.name: vpn_status
children.description: - `CONNECTING` — tunnel being established - `CONNECTED` — tunnel active - `DISCONNECTED` — configured but not connected - `FAILED` — connection failed - `""` — no VPN session

children.name: subscription_plan
children.description: Active data plan. Empty when no subscription. | Value | Description | |-------|-------------| | `FREE_TRIAL` | Free trial | | `1GB` | Monthly 1 GB | | `5GB` | Monthly 5 GB | | `20GB` | Monthly 20 GB | | `2GB` | Daily 2 GB (QA/test) | | `CLOUD` | Cloud plan (daily/yearly/3-year) | | `""` | No subscription |

children.name: subscription_status
children.description: Derived priority: FAILED > PENDING > ACTIVE > INACTIVE. A subscription cancelled at period end remains `ACTIVE` until expiry.

children.name: location
children.description: Omitted (not null) when no GPS fix is available.

children.name: latitude
children.description: WGS-84 latitude in decimal degrees.

children.name: longitude
children.description: WGS-84 longitude in decimal degrees.

children.name: last_updated
children.description: Unix timestamp in milliseconds of the last GPS fix.

remote.python:
import http.client


conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.ui.com")
payload = ''
headers = {
  'Accept': 'application/json',
  'X-API-Key': '<X-API-Key>'
}
conn.request("GET", "/v1/mobility/workspaces/{workspaceID}/devices/{deviceID}", payload, headers)
res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()
print(data.decode("utf-8"))
